The '''Brotherhood of the Obscene Martyr''' was a religious organization that ran afoul of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. [[Theron Shan]] and his guardian, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]], were pursued by this organization during one of their adventures. Shan learned the value of never staying in one place from that incident. The two of them reminisced about that experience upon their reunion on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].
